_note: Single-vocabulary (gold field names only) outcome-equivalence profiles for IGNOAPS.

not_bpl._comment: Verdict changed 2026-10-03 (facts unchanged): ineligible -> UNDETERMINED. Non-BPL, so eligible only via the Para 2.4.3 AIDS-widow carve-out, and this profile doesn't say whether she qualifies for it. See not_bpl_not_aids_widow for the clean ineligible case.

has_family_support._comment: Verdict changed 2026-10-03 (facts unchanged): ineligible -> ELIGIBLE. Family support is no longer a criterion (removed as an interpretive, unsourced test).

govt_employee._comment: Verdict changed 2026-10-03 (facts unchanged): ineligible -> ELIGIBLE. A government job only gates the AIDS-widow carve-out; this applicant qualifies via BPL.

five_acres_land._comment: Verdict changed 2026-10-03 (facts unchanged): ineligible -> ELIGIBLE. Land only gates the AIDS-widow carve-out; this applicant qualifies via BPL.

owns_four_wheeler._comment: Verdict changed 2026-10-03 (facts unchanged): ineligible -> ELIGIBLE. A four-wheeler only gates the AIDS-widow carve-out; this applicant qualifies via BPL.

missing_support_data._comment: Verdict changed 2026-10-03 (facts unchanged): undetermined -> ELIGIBLE. The missing fact (family support) is no longer a criterion, so nothing is missing. missing_bpl_status_undetermined is IGNOAPS's missing-data case now.

not_bpl_not_aids_widow._comment: Added 2026-10-03: non-BPL and not covered by the AIDS-widow carve-out -- the clean ineligible case.

aids_widow_non_bpl_clear_of_criteria._comment: Added 2026-10-03: non-BPL widow living with AIDS, clear of all three Para 2.4.3 criteria -- eligible via the carve-out. Old gold: ineligible (not BPL).

aids_widow_non_bpl_owns_four_wheeler._comment: Added 2026-10-03: as above but owns a four-wheeler for own use -- 'attracted by' a carve-out criterion, so ineligible.

missing_bpl_status_undetermined._comment: Added 2026-10-03: IGNOAPS's missing-data case after the fix -- BPL status unknown. Keeps the per-scheme undetermined probe used for the silent-default analysis.
